source_set.name: Default source
source_set.query: create view dbo.ws_admin_v_audit ( wa_time_stamp, wa_sequence,wa_job, wa_task, wa_status, wa_message,wa_db_msg_desc ) as select wa_time_stamp, wa_sequence,wa_job, wa_task, wa_status, wa_message,wa_db_msg_desc from ws_wrk_audit_log --order by isnull(wa_row_number,0),wa_time_stamp, wa_job, wa_task

source_set.name: Default source
source_set.query: create view dbo.ws_admin_v_dim_col ( dimension_table, dim_display_value, dim_description, dim_type, column_name, business_name, description, data_Type, source_table, source_column, nulls_allowed, numeric, additive, attribute,Format,column_order) AS select dt_table_name, dt_display_name, dt_description, CASE dt_type_ind WHEN 'T' THEN 'Time dimension' WHEN 'V' THEN 'Dimension View' WHEN 'D' THEN 'Dimension' WHEN 'C' THEN 'Slowly changing dimension' WHEN 'P' THEN 'Previous value dimension' ELSE 'Unknown' END, dc_col_name , dc_display_name, dc_src_strategy, dc_data_type, dc_src_table, dc_src_column, dc_nulls_flag, dc_numeric_flag, dc_additive_flag, dc_attribute_flag, dc_format, dc_order from ws_dim_tab LEFT OUTER JOIN ws_dim_col on dt_obj_key = dc_obj_key where dt_type_ind in ('D','C','T','V','P') and isnull(dc_eul_flag,'N') = 'Y'

source_set.name: Default source
source_set.query: create view dbo.ws_admin_v_error ( wd_time_stamp, wd_sequence,wd_job, wd_task, wd_status, wd_message,wd_db_msg_desc ) as select wd_time_stamp, wd_sequence,wd_job, wd_task, wd_status, wd_message,wd_db_msg_desc from ws_wrk_error_log --order by isnull(wd_row_number,0),wd_time_stamp, wd_job, wd_task

source_set.name: Default source
source_set.query: create view dbo.ws_admin_v_fact_col ( "fact_table", "fact_display_value", "fact_description", "fact_type", "column_name", "business_name", "description", "data_Type", "source_table", "source_column", "nulls_allowed", "numeric", "additive", "attribute", "format", "column_order") as select ft_table_name, ft_display_name, ft_description, CASE ft_type_ind WHEN 'D' THEN 'Detail' WHEN 'R' THEN 'Rollup/Combined' WHEN 'S' THEN 'KPI' WHEN 'P' THEN 'Detail partitioned' WHEN 'Q' THEN 'Rollup partitioned' ELSE 'Unknown' END, fc_col_name, fc_display_name, fc_src_strategy, fc_data_type, fc_src_table, fc_src_column, fc_nulls_flag, fc_numeric_flag, fc_additive_flag, fc_attribute_flag, fc_format, fc_order from ws_fact_tab LEFT OUTER JOIN ws_fact_col on ft_obj_key = fc_obj_key where ft_type_ind in ('D','S','R','P','Q') and isnull(fc_eul_flag,'N') = 'Y'

source_set.name: Default source
source_set.query: create view dbo.ws_admin_v_fact_join ( fact_table, fact_column, dimension_table, dimension_column) as select ft_table_name , fc_col_name, fc_src_table, fc_src_column from ws_fact_tab LEFT OUTER JOIN ws_fact_col on ft_obj_key = fc_obj_key where ft_type_ind in ('D','S','R','Q','P') and isnull(fc_join_flag,'N') = 'Y'

source_set.name: Default source
source_set.query: create view dbo.ws_admin_v_sched ( "type", "job_name", "status", "sequence", "started_scheduled", "completed", "hours_elapsed" , "minutes_elapsed", "okay", "info", "warn", "detail", "error") as select 'Waiting', wjc_name, CASE wjc_status WHEN 'H' THEN 'On Hold' WHEN 'R' THEN 'Running' WHEN 'P' THEN 'Pending' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Waiting' WHEN 'C' THEN 'Completed' WHEN 'B' THEN 'Blocked' WHEN 'F' THEN 'Failed' WHEN 'G' THEN 'Failed - Aborted' WHEN 'E' THEN 'Error Completion' ELSE 'Unknown' END, wjc_sequence, wjc_start_after, GETDATE(), 0 , 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from ws_wrk_job_ctrl union select 'Running',wjr_name, CASE wjr_status WHEN 'H' THEN 'On Hold' WHEN 'R' THEN 'Running' WHEN 'P' THEN 'Pending' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Waiting' WHEN 'C' THEN 'Completed' WHEN 'B' THEN 'Blocked' WHEN 'F' THEN 'Failed' WHEN 'G' THEN 'Failed - Aborted' WHEN 'E' THEN 'Error Completion' ELSE 'Unknown' END, wjr_sequence, wjr_started, wjr_completed, CONVERT(integer,DATEDIFF(mi,wjr_started,GETDATE())/60), DATEDIFF(mi,wjr_started,GETDATE()) - CONVERT(integer,DATEDIFF(mi,wjr_started,GETDATE())/60)*60, wjr_okay_count, wjr_info_count, wjr_warning_count, wjr_detail_count, wjr_error_count from ws_wrk_job_run union select 'Finished',wjl_name, CASE wjl_status WHEN 'H' THEN 'On Hold' WHEN 'R' THEN 'Running' WHEN 'P' THEN 'Pending' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Waiting' WHEN 'C' THEN 'Completed' WHEN 'B' THEN 'Blocked' WHEN 'F' THEN 'Failed' WHEN 'G' THEN 'Failed - Aborted' WHEN 'E' THEN 'Error Completion' ELSE 'Unknown' END, wjl_sequence, wjl_started, wjl_completed, wjl_elapsed_hh, wjl_elapsed_mi, wjl_okay_count, wjl_info_count, wjl_warning_count, wjl_detail_count, wjl_error_count from ws_wrk_job_log

source_set.name: Default source
source_set.query: create view dbo.ws_admin_v_task ( "Result", "task_name", "status", "sequence", "started", "completed", "hours_elapsed" , "minutes_elapsed", "info", "warn", "detail", "inserted", "updated", "replaced", "deleted", "discarded", "rejected", "errored") as Select 'Running',wtr_name, CASE wtr_run_status WHEN 'H' THEN 'On Hold' WHEN 'R' THEN 'Running' WHEN 'P' THEN 'Pending' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Waiting' WHEN 'C' THEN 'Completed' WHEN 'B' THEN 'Blocked' WHEN 'F' THEN 'Failed' WHEN 'G' THEN 'Failed - Aborted' WHEN 'E' THEN 'Error Completion' ELSE 'Unknown' END, wtr_sequence, wtr_started, wtr_completed, CONVERT(integer,DATEDIFF(mi,wtr_started,GETDATE())/60), DATEDIFF(mi,wtr_started,GETDATE()) - CONVERT(integer,DATEDIFF(mi,wtr_started,GETDATE())/60)*60, wtr_info_count, wtr_warning_count, wtr_detail_count, wtr_rec_inserted, wtr_rec_updated,wtr_rec_replaced,wtr_rec_deleted,wtr_rec_discarded, wtr_rec_rejected,wtr_rec_errored from ws_wrk_task_run union select wtl_return_msg,wtl_name, CASE wtl_run_status WHEN 'H' THEN 'On Hold' WHEN 'R' THEN 'Running' WHEN 'P' THEN 'Pending' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Waiting' WHEN 'C' THEN 'Completed' WHEN 'B' THEN 'Blocked' WHEN 'F' THEN 'Failed' WHEN 'G' THEN 'Failed - Aborted' WHEN 'E' THEN 'Error Completion' ELSE 'Unknown' END, wtl_sequence, wtl_started, wtl_completed, wtl_elapsed_hh, wtl_elapsed_mi, wtl_info_count, wtl_warning_count, wtl_detail_count, wtl_rec_inserted, wtl_rec_updated,wtl_rec_replaced,wtl_rec_deleted,wtl_rec_discarded, wtl_rec_rejected,wtl_rec_errored from ws_wrk_task_log

source_set.name: Default source
source_set.query: CREATE VIEW dbo.ws_rep_v_track_back AS SELECT lt_table_name AS rb_table_name , CASE WHEN lc_src_table = lt_table_name THEN NULL ELSE lc_src_table END AS rb_src_table , CASE WHEN PATINDEX('%DataWarehouse;%',dc_attributes) = 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS rb_remote_flag FROM ws_load_tab , ws_load_col , ws_dbc_connect WHERE lt_obj_key = lc_obj_key AND lt_connect_key = dc_obj_key AND lt_table_name <> lc_src_table UNION SELECT st_table_name AS rb_table_name , CASE WHEN sc_src_table = st_table_name THEN NULL ELSE sc_src_table END AS rb_src_table , 'N' AS rb_remote_flag FROM ws_stage_tab , ws_stage_col WHERE st_obj_key = sc_obj_key AND ISNULL(sc_join_flag,'N') <> 'Y' AND st_table_name <> sc_src_table UNION SELECT dt_table_name rb_table_name , CASE WHEN dc_src_table = dt_table_name THEN NULL ELSE dc_src_table END AS rb_src_table , 'N' AS rb_remote_flag FROM ws_dim_tab , ws_dim_col WHERE dt_obj_key = dc_obj_key AND dt_table_name <> dc_src_table UNION SELECT ft_table_name rb_table_name , CASE WHEN fc_src_table = ft_table_name THEN NULL ELSE fc_src_table END AS rb_src_table , 'N' AS rb_remote_flag FROM ws_fact_tab , ws_fact_col WHERE ft_obj_key = fc_obj_key AND ISNULL(fc_join_flag,'N') <> 'Y' AND ft_table_name <> fc_src_table UNION SELECT at_table_name rb_table_name , CASE WHEN ac_src_table = at_table_name THEN NULL ELSE ac_src_table END AS rb_src_table , 'N' AS rb_remote_flag FROM ws_agg_tab , ws_agg_col WHERE at_obj_key = ac_obj_key AND ISNULL(ac_join_flag,'N') <> 'Y' AND at_table_name <> ac_src_table UNION SELECT ct_cube_name rb_table_name , CONVERT(varchar,ct_fact_table) AS rb_src_table , 'N' AS rb_remote_flag FROM ws_cube_tab
